name: final
config_label: prompt=v3 tools=verbose verifier=on reader=on renter_guard=on style_precheck=on reasoning_history=on

sourcing.need: sourcing task {opened_at, due_at} on the register

dedupe.need: cross-channel merge by phone/email with sources[]
dedupe.how: two threads, same phone -> one row

two_occupant.need: 2-occupant rent/deposit/utilities on room records, allowed in messages

video.need: walkthrough video asset on rooms + video attachment + video_sent state

event_mode.need: showing mode (in_person / video_call / hybrid) on calendar events

scheduler.need: follow-up state on the register + a sandbox clock tick that emits due check-ins

quiet_window.need: clock-driven quiet windows in the sandbox (120 s small-talk wait, cancel on answer)
quiet_window.how: no sandbox mechanism; live driver only

items.text: No prospect message has more than 2 sentences.
No prospect message contains more than one question.
In a burst only the last message holds a question, and nothing is sent after it until the prospect replies.
No em or en dash in any prospect or owner message.
Prospect messages never refer to the owner in the third person.
Every dollar figure in a message exists in the room or listing record.
A public listing or post never contains the house number.
items.detail: msg-listing-street-only:no_house_number (listing text matches /\b407\b/: Room in shared home - 407 Halloway Loop, Durham Private room in shared home at …)

items.text: The full address is sent to a prospect only once their showing is confirmed.
items.detail: msg-owner-confirms:address_after_confirm (none of ['407 Halloway'])

items.text: When 2-occupant pricing exists, the single-occupant rate is stated first.
items.detail: blocked: needs 2-occupant rent/deposit/utilities on room records, allowed in messages

items.text: Lease asked as 'Is a one year lease okay?'; move-in asked for the exact date.
A thread that started in Spanish gets only Spanish replies until the prospect switches.
After 2+ incoherent English replies the next message is one 'Do you speak <language>?' question; no switch before a yes.
items.detail: msg-language-probe:probe_after_two (last message lacks ['spanish', 'español']: Thanks for confirming the lease. What is your exact intended move-in date?)

items.text: The suspected language is never inferred from the name alone.
On a new listing thread, full disclosure (type, private/shared, rent, deposit, utilities, street, availability) comes before the first gate question.
items.detail: msg-full-gate:disclosure (before the first gate question (0 msgs) missing: rent, deposit, utilities, street, availability, type, private_shared)

items.text: House rules (pets, no smoking, no parties) are stated before qualifying.
items.detail: msg-full-gate:house_rules (before the first gate question (0 msgs) missing: smoking, parties, pets)

items.text: The walkthrough video is sent before any showing is proposed; with no video the owner is told.
items.detail: blocked: needs walkthrough video asset on rooms + video attachment + video_sent state

items.text: Never states an availability date in the past; an active listing with no future date is 'available now'.
An unconfirmed listing fact is never quoted; the agent says it will confirm and escalates.
items.detail: msg-unconfirmed-fact:never_quotes_it (matches /(?<!whether )(?<!if )\b(it'?s|it is|comes|room is)\s+(fully\s+)?(un)?furnished\b|\b(not|isn'?t)\s+furnished\b/: Hi Dana, I'm not sure if the room is furnished; the record shows the furnish st…); msg-unconfirmed-fact:escalated (0 matching escalations)

items.text: Never proposes a showing time (text or calendar) before all five gate items are exact.
A vague answer leaves the item pending and the next question asks for the exact answer.
An item already given (even volunteered out of order) is never asked again (one confirmation allowed, D23).
A time proposed with items pending: no event, acknowledge, details first, end with the pending question.
items.detail: msg-skip-ahead:skip_reply (none of ['first', 'before', 'detail', 'few things', 'couple of things', 'questions']: Hi Dana, what is your exact intended move-in date?)

items.text: A content-free reply gets one message that acknowledges it and re-asks the item in different wording.
The small-talk re-ask waits about 120 s and is cancelled if a real answer arrives.
items.detail: blocked: needs clock-driven quiet windows in the sandbox (120 s small-talk wait, cancel on answer)

items.text: A third small-talk non-answer on the same item escalates instead of a third re-ask.
items.detail: msg-small-talk-third:at_most_three_asks (asked move_in again at step 15 (asks at steps [5, 6, 13, 15]; 3 confirmation allowed))

items.text: The 6-month option is never mentioned before the prospect asks for a shorter lease.
After a shorter-lease ask, 6+ months closes the lease item with no owner check; below 6 is never agreed and escalates.
items.detail: msg-shorter-3:escalated_short (0 matching escalations)

items.text: A price/discount request is escalated with a draft, at most one holding line, and the gate continues.
A proxy poster is recorded with proxy.is_proxy and the actual seeker and occupant count are confirmed.
items.detail: msg-proxy:proxy_recorded (proxy=None); msg-proxy:asks_actual_seeker (none of ['friend', 'who will', 'her name', 'she'])

items.text: Proposed slots sit inside an availability block, overlap no other showing; non-showing events are ignored.
The prospect is never told a time is confirmed until the owner confirms it.
items.detail: msg-proposed-not-confirmed:proposed (propose_showing x0)

items.text: Owner confirmation by either signal produces exactly one 'confirmed' message.
An owner reject leads to an alternative or a polite close, never a confirmation.
items.detail: msg-owner-rejects:tells_prospect (no messages)

items.text: On confirmation the one-hour-before rule is sent as its own message, and the deadline is stored on the event.
items.detail: msg-owner-confirms:one_hour_rule_own_message (a present True, b present False)

items.text: Without an on-the-way message by the start time, no showing and the owner is told (no_show state: not checked).
items.detail: msg-no-show:owner_told_no_show (0 matching owner notifications)

items.text: Hybrid mode: the prospect is told before travel; never confirmed without the owner confirming a housemate.
items.detail: blocked: needs showing mode (in_person / video_call / hybrid) on calendar events

items.text: A video call follows the same proposed then confirmed flow and phone requirement.
items.detail: blocked: needs showing mode (in_person / video_call / hybrid) on calendar events

items.text: After a showing's end the owner gets exactly one 'did it happen?' ping; nothing goes to the prospect.
On the owner's yes: warm line, application link, what it asks, then 'Are you interested in moving forward?' last.
items.detail: msg-post-tour:post_tour_order (never sent any of ['great', 'glad', 'nice to meet', 'thanks for coming', 'good to', 'thank you for'])

items.text: The application link is never sent without a confirmed tour, and never twice.
items.detail: msg-app-link-once:no_link_before_tour (3 matching messages); msg-app-link-once:link_exactly_once (3 matching messages)

items.text: Check-ins follow 12, 12, 12, 12, 24, 24, 48, 96... hours from the application send or last reply.
items.detail: msg-cadence:nothing_at_18h (sent 1: Hi Dana, are you still interested in moving forward with the room on Halloway L…); msg-cadence:checkin_at_24h (0 matching messages)

items.text: A substantive reply resets the cadence (next check-in 12 h after it); no check-in at the old due time.
items.detail: msg-cadence-reset:no_checkin_at_old_due (sent 1: Hi Dana, just checking if you're still planning to move forward with the applic…); msg-cadence-reset:checkin_12h_after_reply (0 matching messages)

items.text: Applied / not interested / found a place stop the cadence with one owner report (45-day cold: needs scheduler).
items.detail: msg-applied-stops:one_owner_report (2 matching owner notifications)

items.text: A not-now reply gets one warm message and one timeframe question; never closed.
items.detail: msg-not-now:timeframe_question (none of ['when']: Thanks for letting me know, Dana. Is there anything else I can help you with?)

items.text: A not-now prospect is parked with reconnect_at from their timeframe (named month = the 1st).
items.detail: msg-park-month:reconnect_at (reconnect_at missing); msg-park-month:status_not_now (register[t_dana].status=new)

items.text: With no timeframe after asking, reconnect_at = now + 30 days.
items.detail: msg-park-default:reconnect_at (reconnect_at missing); msg-park-default:status_not_now (register[t_dana].status=new)

items.text: On reconnect_at exactly one reconnect message goes out, naming a room only if still live (48 h cadence: needs scheduler).
A hard no gets one short kind close and status lost, and nothing after.
items.detail: msg-hard-no:status_lost (register[t_dana].status missing)

items.text: A qualified prospect moving in months away is parked; the check-back is a draft for the owner.
items.detail: msg-far-out:no_showing_now (propose_showing called at step 18); msg-far-out:checkback_draft_for_owner (0 matching owner notifications); msg-far-out:draft_present (0 matching owner notifications); msg-far-out:parked (register[t_dana].status=showing_proposed)

items.text: A thread tied to a listing never gets a 'which listing?' question.
An ambiguous inquiry gets one short message per live listing and one 'which one?' before disclosure.
items.detail: msg-routing:one_line_per_listing_then_which (last message lacks ['which', 'interest', 'prefer']: Hi Rae, I have rooms in Durham, Raleigh and Chapel Hill. How long do you want t…)

items.text: The pick is recorded as listing_of_interest and updated on a switch (interest_history: not checked).
items.detail: msg-routing:pick_then_switch_recorded (register[t_rae].listing_of_interest=None)

items.text: When the picked room is unavailable, other live rooms are offered.
items.detail: msg-room-filled:offers_other_room (none of ['Halloway'])

items.text: In a thread the owner took over, the agent sends nothing and escalates every new message.
items.detail: msg-stand-down:sends_nothing (sent 1: Hi Dana, I've noted your message. Let me check on that and I'll get back to you.)

items.text: In sandbox or live mode nothing reaches a real person without the owner's click.
Several messages before a reply produce one reply that accounts for all of them.
An inbound message unanswered for 10 minutes raises an owner alert.
items.detail: blocked: needs 10-minute unanswered alert (clock + alert event)

items.text: No tool deletes a register row.
A person on a second channel (same phone or email) is merged into one row with both sources.
items.detail: msg-second-channel:one_row (2 rows, want 1); msg-second-channel:both_threads_on_row (register[renter:dana].thread_ids=['t_dana'])

items.text: A non-fit seeker is captured, gets an honest 'noted' reply, and a sourcing task with a due date.
items.detail: msg-non-fit:honest_reply (none of ['noted', 'note', 'keep', 'reach out', 'let you know', 'when something']); msg-non-fit:sourcing_task (sourcing=None)

items.text: Matching (concierge matcher match_inventory) disqualifies on type, budget >15% below rent, occupants, a known banned pet, a short stay; unknowns never disqualify; <2 stated criteria is not matchable.
Area phrases resolve to sets (airport -> Morrisville, airport-to-Garner corridor -> Cary, Raleigh); unknown phrases never disqualify.
The weekly rollup reports captures, totals, WATCH (3+), SUPPLY SIGNAL (5+ qualified), matches, stale rows.
items.detail: tool-rollup:matches_with_reasons (data lacks 'match'); tool-rollup:stale_rows (data lacks 'stale')

items.text: A cluster of 5 with unqualified, no-budget or proxy entries is reported as nominal, not a signal.
When a room becomes available, match_renters runs before publish_listing and matches go to the owner first.
items.detail: msg-match-before-publish:match_before_publish (publish_listing at step 4 before match_renters); msg-match-before-publish:matched_surfaced_to_owner (0 matching owner notifications)

items.text: Pet answers follow R-PET-1/2: enclosed lizard yes, enclosed rabbit no, dog no (cat fee quoting: needs fee fields).
items.detail: msg-pet-rabbit:pet_answer (none of ['not allowed', "can't", 'cannot', 'sorry', 'unfortunately', 'no rodents', 'no rabbits', 'no roaming', 'no dogs', "isn't allowed"]); msg-pet-dog:pet_answer (none of ['not allowed', "can't", 'cannot', 'sorry', 'unfortunately', 'no rodents', 'no rabbits', 'no roaming', 'no dogs', "isn't allowed"])

items.text: A tenant who cannot pay on time gets a plan proposed to the owner; the agent never agrees, waives or threatens.

note: DEVELOPMENT CHECK, not a headline number: one run per scenario, no seeds, scenarios written alongside the system. Final config does not expose lane 2 concierge tools (prompt v3, verbose tools).
